label: Every story night, 10/20, three more games & the rebuilt runtime

next.title: S2: the first host-versus-phone state difference
next.body: As of full06-input-registration-20260928, the phone's audio has Balloon Boy hopping at the 40.0 s roll of full-06 while the rebuild and the model hold him at CAM 10, and what held him is UNKNOWN. The record leaves S2 open.

next.title: An office trace from the rebuild on the phone
next.body: As of recompile-practice-apk-ad92f5548c4cf9a5, the FNaF 2 research rebuild installs and boots on the phone, and no office encounter trace has been collected on it.

next.title: FNaF 4 Night 4 and the Fredbear nights
next.body: As of fnaf4-nights-1-3-20260925 and fnaf4-night5-n5b-20260927, FNaF 4 Night 4's best attempt died 0.24 s before 6 AM and the first Night 5 died at 38.7 s; the nights toward 20/20/20/20 are played, not seeded.

missing.title: Two committed winners with no pack
missing.body: As of review-promotions-20260929, campaign-night1-minus7-winner.json and campaign-toys-night5-winner.json are MODEL_ONLY winners that no run pack names, and UNTRACKED_WINNER_DEBT is 1 of 1.

missing.title: A rate for any binding but k3
missing.body: The k3 cohort's 8 of 10 is one ten-run measurement of one binding, not a rate for other bindings, and the model predicted no rate for it.

missing.title: A promotion path for FNaF 1, 3 and 4
missing.body: The FNaF 1 4/20 and FNaF 4 story-night 6 AMs record no Plan 12 edge, and the evidence CLI does not read FNaF 1 run records.

missing.title: A FNaF 3 policy that takes every seed
missing.body: As of fnaf3-stage1-g275-census-20260930, no policy in the FNaF 3 model reaches 6 AM on every seed under the corrected attack-stage rule.

entries.title: Night 1 reached 6 AM on 2026-09-07, not 2026-09-05
entries.body: The victory record names campaign-2026-09-07T05-05-15.429Z and nine consecutive sixam lifecycle frames from 2026-09-07T05:12:32Z, and it was recorded the same day. The entry night1-device-clear dated this clear 2026-09-05; this entry corrects the date and nothing else: one bounded HID schedule under the minus-toys policy, armed after a verified cam:9+cam:11 split.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Night 2 reached 6 AM on 2026-09-07, not 2026-09-05
entries.body: The victory record names campaign-2026-09-07T15-40-41.895Z and eleven consecutive sixam lifecycle frames from 2026-09-07T15:47:57Z; the record itself was written on 2026-09-08. The entry night2-device-clear dated this clear 2026-09-05; this entry corrects the date and nothing else: one bounded HID schedule under the minus-toys policy, armed on the first attempt after a verified cam:9+cam:11 split.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Moving the Night 5 mask press off the animation seam did not lower the correction rate
entries.body: The qualification of 2026-09-11 moved the loop mask press from 400 ms to 449 ms after monitor-down and predicted that the CORRECTED gate rate, about 13% over two runs, would fall. It did not: 4 of 16 gates corrected, and the run died in lifecycle static about 157 s in. The seam between the monitor-down animation and the mask press is not what loses that press. Every corrected gate had decided on a frame whose screen the classifier could not identify.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The late-repair reading of the Night 5 mask deficit is no longer certain
entries.body: night5-mask-tick-budget attributed a 0.9 s deficit in corrected mask windows to a repair that arrives 800 ms late. If part of the corrections are spurious, some of those short windows were created by the gate rather than repaired by it. The deficit stays measured and the 800 ms arithmetic stands; the causal reading does not.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: A Night 5 run died to Mangle at 3 AM, and Minus Toys has no stun for her
entries.body: Mangle killed the run 237.5 s into the night, 2.3 s after the third of three mask corrections in 24 cycles; each correction had found the mask off while the route believed it on. The route has no stun for Mangle by construction, and its one defence is a counter that every parity correction resets. The model scores this exact plan 3000/3000 at epoch 0; the record does not decide whether the model's Mangle is wrong or the phone delivered something the model did not.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Night 5 reached 6 AM on the phone
entries.body: Run night5-anchor2-20260912T204002Z won with 42 of 42 cycle gates AGREED, no corrections and no gate aborts, and the menu then offered 6th Night. The binding is fnv1a-81b5e51c, the contact-final bundle under the minus-toys policy, armed observe-once. One clear, not a rate.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: A longer Night 5 cycle collapses instead of buying slack
entries.body: At 3000 seeds the route scores 3000/3000 with a 10000 ms loop and 0/3000 at 15000 ms and at 20000 ms: spacing the mask windows further apart lets an approach complete between them. The period is load-bearing in both directions.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The Withered Bonnie death-cause model failed its first held-out night and was withdrawn
entries.body: Built from one jumpscare's frames (9 positives, 24 negatives), it produced 24 false positives on the next run and did not fire on that run's actual jumpscare, which was Foxy at 192.2 s after Balloon Boy had entered the office. Rebuilding it with both runs' negatives made its margin worse, not better.
entries.label: CALIBRATED

entries.title: Night 5 was won again with the post-mask hall flash removed
entries.body: Run night5-noflash-20260913T003456Z reached 6 AM with the hall flash row dropped (hallMs 0) and everything else as in the third win: 42 of 42 gates agreed over 256 scheduled contacts, none of them a hall flash. On video its 42 mask windows ran 3.5 to 5.58 s, median 5.08 s, three of them under 5 s.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Night 6 reached 6 AM, and Custom Night was unlocked
entries.body: Run night6-anchoredh1-20260913T180208Z won with binding h (fnv1a-37278c63), released 0.45 ms after its aim of 4870 ms on the five-second Foxy roll grid: 42 of 42 gates agreed, and the video shows the 6 AM screen at 448.5 s. The title afterwards offered Custom Night. Bindings e, f and g had died at 155.5, 165.5 and 195.5 s, each moving the post-mask flash further ahead of the roll it must beat.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The first 10/20 6 AM on the phone
entries.body: Run night7-k2-aim2433-maskoff7000-20260914T004106Z won Night 7 with all ten Custom Night dials at 20 and the puppet at 15 (the Golden Freddy preset): binding k2 (fnv1a-7e4bf3e8), released 2.49 ms after its aim of 2433 ms, 42 of 42 gates agreed, and the 6 AM screen on video at 455.0 s.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Night 7 at 4/20 was won by a Minus 3 loop with no mask input
entries.body: Run night7-n7-420-minimal-m3-20260914T020543Z reached 6 AM with the four withered animatronics at 20, every other dial at 0 and the puppet pinned at 15, on a Minus 3 clear loop cut to four rows per 10 s (hall flash, monitor up, wind, camdrop): 41 gates agreed and the 6 AM screen is on video at 453.5 s. The two attempts before it died at about 20 s and 56 s.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: A predeclared ten-run k2 cohort won 3 of 10
entries.body: Ten counted k2 nights at 10/20 gave 3 wins and 7 deaths, with no invalid run; two slots were excluded before any gameplay input, one for a preflight refusal and one for a helper failure. The record gives the cohort's completion as 2026-09-15T00:00:05Z. The model scores k2 65536/65536 at the delivered phase, and the Foxy chain record puts the seven lost nights to Withered Foxy.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Early anchor authorization does not cause the k2 Foxy deaths
entries.body: Before r05's outcome the cohort recorded a prediction: r05 was authorized 1569 ms before onset, like the two runs that had died (r02, r04), so if early authorization caused the Foxy deaths r05 would die to Withered Foxy near cycle phase 7.5 s. r05 won, with the video clear at 455.0 s: early authorization is not sufficient for a death.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Two refused hall flashes in a row do not explain the k2 Foxy kills
entries.body: A candidate held that a post-mask hall flash refused after a defended encounter leaves Withered Foxy un-reset. The lost run r02 had back-to-back refused (FLAT) flashes before Foxy struck in cycle 29, but the cohort record marks the candidate refuted as stated: two refused flashes in a row are not sufficient for a Foxy kill. r04 died in cycle 1, before any streak could form.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The k2 death causes read by the cycle ledger were retracted
entries.body: tools/device/cycle-ledger.py had the Night 6 bindings' timings built in (mask on 4249, mask off 9460, flash 10060, camdrop 13650 ms), while k2 runs 1749, 7000, 7460 and 11150 ms, so every column it printed for r02 and r04 was sampled 2.46 to 2.60 s after the event it names. Those two ledger causes, and the clause of an open observation resting on them, were retracted inside the cohort; the ledger now reads each run's own winner timings.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Blackout-loop audio could not recover a Night 6 seed
entries.body: Scoring the blackout-loop audio onsets of two Night 6 runs against every seed left nine seeds tied on the won run and 1687 on the other, and no pair of runs agreed on the clock constant K. INCONCLUSIVE, not a refutation: under these routes those onsets fall inside the route's own scheduled blackout windows, so the schedule sets them, not a roll.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The model's Foxy-chain deaths were a model error
entries.body: With the drop-light order and Foxy's roll chain written as the event sheet has them (options sourcedDropLightOrder and sourcedFoxyChain, both off by default), k2 lost 2999 of 3000 seeds to Foxy. Once the lit counter is kept as the persistent counter the sheet uses, the literal chain wins every seed on k2, k3 and Night 6 h: the 2999/3000 was the model's drop-frame latch, not a phone mechanism.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The phone's Foxy deaths are not the model's Foxy death
entries.body: All five timed k2 deaths came in cycles with no office encounter at the camdrop, about 1.5% if death cycles followed the base rate. The model's only Foxy-death path, a lock after an encounter-blocked camdrop flash, is therefore not the phone's. Four of the five death cycles show no camdrop hall light, against about 40% of other encounter-free cycles; why a camdrop would fail to latch on the phone is open.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: A lost 33 ms hall flash does not explain the Foxy deaths
entries.body: The model can lose k2 to Foxy if a share of hall contacts is eaten: 2251 of 3000 seeds win at 5% lost and 870 at 20%. The phone does not show it: none of 107 undefended cycles read a refused (FLAT) flash.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Binding k3 won its first 10/20 night
entries.body: Run night7-night7-k3-wallclock-r1-20260915T002238Z reached 6 AM: 42 of 42 gates agreed, the anchor released 0.27 ms after its aim of 2433 ms and was authorized on the latch, and the 6 AM screen is on video at 456.5 s. The run was stamped with the phone's wall clock for a seed-clock test.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The first encounter prediction for a k3 night was not supported, then reopened
entries.body: Scored against every cycle's right-eyehole read, the prediction was NOT SUPPORTED on the model of that morning. It was reopened the same day because that model lacked g744's one global draw per second, which puts every candidate's random stream out of step with the game's from the first second. The rescore was inconclusive.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: Two k3 nights started at one wall-clock residue did not share a seed
entries.body: The predeclared rule called twins on agreement across all of at least 8 jointly identified cycles, and refuted them on disagreement only when the two nights' onset residues were within 50 ms. A and B agreed on 0 of 12 cycles, but their residues were 62 ms apart: INCONCLUSIVE. The seed is taken at the end of the office frame's loading, and loading jitter the Start tap cannot control moved the two nights' clocks by tens of milliseconds.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The model spends a fraction of the Office frame's random draws
entries.body: 113 Office groups hold 123 random draws, several of them unconditional (every frame, every 100 ms, every 490 ms, every second); the model has 22 draw sites, all gameplay rolls. The game spends at least about 84 draws a second unconditionally, so the model's random stream leaves the phone's from the first frame, and seed-specific encounter predictions cannot identify a phone night even at the true seed.
entries.label: SOURCED

entries.title: Missing route forks are why the model queued a Withered Freddy the phone never shows
entries.body: On k3 r1 and k2 r03 the right-eyehole reader identified 39 Withered Chica and Bonnie encounters and no Withered Freddy, while the model queued about 9.6 Freddy encounters a night. The model lacked the per-second decide-path draw (g744), Freddy's CAM 03 fork (g376, g377) and his return from hall stage 2 (g378). With them, behind option sourcedRouteForks (off by default), Freddy falls to about 3.0 encounters a night and the census still wins 3000 of 3000.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The vent-light anchors do not contradict the phone after all
entries.body: Re-read with the corrected instance rule, the Office layout puts the phone's measured left-LIGHT tap inside the left light box. Three readings of 2026-08-26 are retracted: that both anchors were parked off the frame, that the light hitboxes had no frame-3 instance, and that a placed position in the dump was no evidence of a runtime position for a mobile HUD object. Closed at the source level; no device run was needed.
entries.label: SOURCED

entries.title: Two hall-stage markers set the hall-movement counter
entries.body: The hall movement counter (g875-g881) is set to 300 when a character moves onto the hall stage 1 or hall stage 2 trigger marker. The model carries that entry rule behind option sourcedHallEntry, off by default.
entries.label: SOURCED

entries.title: The model's seed pick for a won Night 6 is retracted; the clock names the seed
entries.body: Timing the office frame's first frame against the game's log places the seeding call between two adjacent log lines, which pins the won Night 6 to seed 51376 or 51377, and two earlier k3 nights to one seed each (full-06 47593, full-04 34043). The model-based census and its pick of 51380 are superseded: the model is not faithful enough to name a seed.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: No seed reproduces the won Night 6 in the model
entries.body: The observable carries enough information (59.7 bits against 16 needed), and wrong seeds floor at 6 to 13 errors against a known model night, but the model's trajectory decorrelates under input-latency uncertainty where that information arrives: 16 bits accumulate only by window 16 or so, while a 6 ms latency error already changes the night by window 11. No seed of the bracket fits at any stream offset up to 2000 draws.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The phone's own touches do not lock the model to a k3 night
entries.body: Driven by the phone's real presses on the game's frame clock, the model reproduces the phone's 300 s survival for every seed, and its Foxy death for a fifth of seeds at 83 to 85 ms latency, but the night's outcome is chaotic in the input latency at the 2 ms level, and the best eyehole fit (seed 30831, 16 of 17) lies outside the dex-verified bracket.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: Six Night 6 runs gave no seed twins
entries.body: The activating press was placed to 0.007 ms on an idle host and the seed followed it by a steady 4849 ms, so four aimed nights landed their seeds within 14 ms of each other (24850, 24851, 24853, 24864). Twins need two on the same millisecond, and the measured window (37 ms of delay spread plus a busy host's press error) asks for about eight aimed nights; six were run, four of them aimed.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The model's all-seeds loss on a won Night 6 was two wall clocks, not a rule
entries.body: The model killed all 600 censused seeds on night6-c2-01, a Night 6 the phone won with 42 of 42 gates. No rule was wrong: the schedule's origin and every gate stamp were on the host's wall clock, the office seed on the phone's, and on that run the two stood 1374.8 ms apart. Corrected, the model reaches 6 AM on all 65,536 seeds.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: All ten Custom Night presets clear 3000/3000 in the model, after one floor moved
entries.body: In four lanes, at a device band wider than the phone's worst measured spread, the Minus Toys preset schedule clears every preset 3000/3000 (120,000 simulated nights, no loss) once the Foxy-reset hall pulse moves from 9500 to 9613 ms, off a 50 ms clearance it had inherited from the route it protects. Before the move 10/20 scored 107 of 200 at the same band, every loss to Foxy. Nothing was run on the phone.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: A predeclared ten-run k3 cohort won 8 of 10 at 10/20
entries.body: Eight of ten predeclared k3 nights reached 6 AM, every win graded clear by video. Both deaths were Withered Foxy on the first office frame after a mask-off press, 20.0 s and 70.2 s into the night, and the anchor landed within 1.05 ms of its aim on all ten. One ten-run measurement of one binding, not a rate for other bindings; the model predicted no rate for it.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Two Night 6 runs shared an office seed
entries.body: By the predeclared rule, night6-tw-12 and night6-twin-01 both bracket their office seed to a single millisecond, and both read low16 24850; the second was forced by a device-side clock pin.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: A shared seed does not replay the night
entries.body: The two twin nights parted at their first real encounter, about 1 AM: in one, Balloon Boy entered the office and the night ended in a game over six seconds later; in the other, Mangle was in the office at that point and Withered Chica in the next mask window. A shared seed fixes where the random sequence starts, not how far along it each event reads it.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: On the phone's own frame clock, the model survives where the phone did
entries.body: Driven by each night's own frame intervals, seed and clock-derived phase, the model survives both frame-traced Night 6 nights, as the phone did: night6-ft-01 (seed 24926) for all 335 s before the executor stopped, and night6-tw-04 (seed 24883 or 24884) to 6 AM. The survival band runs from 175 ms early to 50 ms late of the clock-derived phase, and the game's own phase sits about 30 to 37 ms late, inside it.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The model does not predict who is in which mask window
entries.body: On the traced Night 6 6 AM night6-tw-04 the phone shows 11 occupied mask windows; the model at the night's own seed, frame trace and phase matches 2. Stepping the seed up to 300 draws either way reaches at best 8 of 11, and so does the best of 1,202 random seeds: the fit is at chance. Across every seed the model's nights are about half again as busy as the phone's and start two cycles earlier.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: A 10/20 night was won with the teach panel narrating
entries.body: night7-k3-teach-02 ran binding k3 at 10/20 with the Cue Helper's teach panel narrating from 2.4 s after onset to the 6 AM screen, and won: executor sixam, the video clear at 456.0 s (graded with the panel's rectangle blanked), 42 of 42 gates, the anchor 0.17 ms late. The panel's words are the executor's schedule, not an observation.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The first Night 5 schedule won again from a re-emitted bundle
entries.body: night5-n5-carry-aim172-20260918T012153Z ran the schedule that won Night 5 on 2026-09-12, byte for byte, from a bundle re-emitted against the current engine, and reached 6 AM: 42 of 42 gates agreed, none corrected or aborted.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Minus 7 reached 6 AM on the phone for the first time
entries.body: Until 2026-09-19 every committed winner was Minus Toys, and the device lane had run one of the eight community strategies. Minus 7 then reached 6 AM on Night 1, and Minus Toys on Night 2, taking the story save from Night 1 to Night 3. Both runs were machine-only with promotion suppressed, because no qualification is bound to these winners.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Minus 3 died twice on Night 3, its canonical night
entries.body: The first device executions of Minus 3 died at 199.5 s, and at 399.6 s to Balloon Boy and Foxy.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: FNaF 3 Night 1 reached 6 AM on the same handset
entries.body: One tap on LOAD GAME, gated on the validated title model, then zero input: the office held about 240 s, which the dump's 40 s per hour gives for Night 1, and the title afterwards read LOAD GAME 2, so the game itself banked the night. A zero-input Night 1 is not a route result and not a Plan 12 rung.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The tap predicted to flip FNaF 3's monitor opened the maintenance panel
entries.body: On Night 2, one tap at the coordinate measured from the first run's office frames opened the maintenance panel and its four reboot options: that coordinate is the maintenance tab, and the monitor flip stayed unmeasured. The record also names a defect: the ad-hoc capture loop had force-stopped the game during a post-night minigame, and the night survived only because FNaF 3 banks it first.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: FNaF 3's title gates read zero on a real non-title screen
entries.body: With one tap onto the Options screen, both gates of the FNaF 3 title model read exactly 0.0000 against floors of 0.20 and 0.10, so their absent side is measured rather than assumed. A frame 4 s after backing out landed in the undecided band and the observer returned ambiguous. The New Game dialog negative was not measured, so the model may not gate a NEW GAME tap.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Two Night 6 deaths named a five-tick mask window, and a 300 ms longer hold won
entries.body: Two Night 6 runs of binding h died on 2026-09-20 to the same mechanism, read on video in both: a defence that needs five continuous fully masked one-second ticks, where h holds the mask fully on for 4811 ms, which contains five whole-second boundaries only at a lucky phase. h2 holds it 5111 ms (mask off 9260 to 9560 ms, the time taken from idle), five ticks at every phase, and reached 6 AM on its first attempt. Both runs were machine-only, with promotion suppressed.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Night 6's wind has no 200 ms to give the mask
entries.body: Buying the longer mask from the wind instead (h3: wind 3030 to 2830 ms, camdrop 13650 to 13450 ms, 5311 ms fully on) scores 68 of 3000 at epoch 4871. Taking mask from winding stops being possible here, which is why h2 takes its 300 ms from idle.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The claim that the phone cannot deliver an aim near the onset was withdrawn the same day
entries.body: The anchor was never on in the run it was measured from: night-run.sh looked the anchor period up by winner hash even under an explicit aim override, the Night 6 winner had no register entry, and the script turned the anchor off. That run and a later aim-255 run both released unanchored at a drawn phase, which is why a 255 ms change in the request moved the delivered epoch by 10 ms.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The shipped Minus Toys mask window has zero margin for Balloon Boy, and the model does not see it
entries.body: Balloon Boy leaves only after five one-second ticks with the mask fully on (g292-g294, g907), and the put-on does not count as fully on. The shipped cycle holds the mask 4551 ms fully on, which spans four or five boundaries depending on phase. The model scores Night 3 3000/3000 with Balloon Boy never inside. Story nights 3, 4 and 5 cleared again that day after an app-data wipe had reset the save; Night 6 stayed open.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: FNaF 1's 4/20 was won on the phone, twice in four nights
entries.body: Two of four FNaF 1 Custom Night 20/20/20/20 nights reached 6 AM, both run without a screen recording. Both recorded nights died, at 75 s to Chica and at about 226 s to Bonnie, with the helper's capture starved to about 10 frames a second. No predeclared cohort and no Plan 12 edge; the evidence CLI does not read FNaF 1 run records.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: FNaF 4 Nights 1-3 were won on the phone by sound and native frames
entries.body: Each of FNaF 4's first three story nights reached 6 AM, Night 3 with the teach panel narrating and a video. The APK disallows backup, so the save cannot be seeded and every night toward 20/20/20/20 is played. One win per night, no predeclared cohort, no Plan 12 edge.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: FNaF 4 Night 4: the best attempt died 0.24 s before 6 AM
entries.body: Eleven Night 4 attempts each named a mechanic the loop had wrong, and each was fixed in the runner; none reached 6 AM.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: Lost campaign directories can be recovered from their run logs
entries.body: On the nine campaigns that kept both their directory and their night-run campaign.log, the events recovered from the log are byte-identical to the originals 9 of 9, and the printed result 7 of 7; the other two ended in ERROR envelopes that were never printed.
entries.label: SOURCED

entries.title: Every story night has a committed winner the model scores 65536/65536
entries.body: Replayed as its bundle gate replays it, a committed winner wins every night the model can deal for each of Nights 1-7, so P_max = 1 in that exact lane. The phone falls short with bindings this lane scores perfect: k2 3 of 10, k3 8 of 10. The record names the gap as delivery (the frame phase the phone re-rolls, lateness, loss) and encounter fidelity (S2), which this lane does not price.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: FNaF 3's published line wins only at a pace no player or phone keeps
entries.body: The published line's 3000/3000 comes from looking five times a second. At the phone's pace the tracking loop holds Nightmare on 99.2% of seeds in both blocks, and Aggressive Nightmare costs it 13 points (86.9% and 87.0%). With the camera drain the model had not seen, the same loop holds Nightmare on 69%.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: 47 won nights carry a Plan 12 promotion edge
entries.body: Of 180 run packs, 48 hold an executor-proven 6 AM, and 47 were attested and promoted: Nights 1-4 two each, Night 5 seven, Night 6 eight, and Night 7 24 (21 at 10/20, one at Balloon Boy and Foxy 20, two at Balloon Boy and Golden Freddy 20). Each edge in the evidence graph names who attested it, an agent under Pedro's delegation of 2026-09-27, and its custody. A promotion is one clear, not a reliability claim.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The 4/20 Minus 3 win is refused promotion
entries.body: night7-n7-420-minimal-m3 is the one executor 6 AM without an edge: it fails the plan12Attestation and winnerCommitted checks, and its custody is recovered from the run log.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: FNaF 2 converts, builds, boots and packages from its own CCN
entries.body: The recompile converts FNaF 2's build-296 CCN, builds it for the host, boots it under the harness without input and packages it as a research APK (org.fnaf2rebuild.play), with all 67 declared sounds resolved. The same record holds a row for each of FNaF 1, 3 and 4, and every APK row reads OK. Rebuilt-runtime fidelity: nothing here is retail evidence.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The rebuilt runtime diverges from the phone on all four clock-seeded nights
entries.body: Replayed at each night's established seed on the phone's own frame clock, the rebuild's first disagreeing mask windows are tw-12 window 9, twin-01 window 10, full-04 window 3 and full-06 window 6; at each, its occupant had reached the office 3.9 to 4.0 s before the mask went on, so none is a boundary between windows. The model on the same inputs shares the difference, so it is not a rebuild-versus-model rule gap. The retained evidence cannot separate the replayed input from the Android runtime's clock. S2 stays open.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: In the rebuild, every Withered attack follows a held-tap drop
entries.body: Every Withered attack in the rebuild replays follows a held-tap drop 6 to 9 s earlier: the k3 route's 200 ms monitor hold spans 13 updates of the phone clock against a 12-update raise, and g618 reads the still-held finger over the drop button as a drop. Under the primary replay rule that kills full-04 at 36.3 s (the phone lived to about 104 s) and full-06 at 377.3 s (the phone won).
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: Sourced countdown and movement-order corrections do not close the encounter gap
entries.body: After the mask-animation input change the tw-04 reproduction stays at 2 of 11 and 1 of 11 windows at its bracket seeds. Gated Every timers expose short-mask Balloon Boy and Mangle failures but do not improve the encounter hits, and their lower total occupancy is largely early death; the option stays off by default. S2 remains open.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The rebuild-matching model options change no committed binding's score
entries.body: Over 26 subjects (22 distinct replays), each on 3000 design and 3000 held-out seeds, the default model wins every seed of both blocks, and under the options that match the rebuilt runtime every subject scores identically, with or without the camera footstep markers.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: CAM 01-04 hops do draw the footstep cue
entries.body: The event sheet, the CCN geometry and the dex agree, and the rebuilt runtime draws on Toy Bonnie's CAM 03 hop: the inference of 8a7288b from full-06's audio, that only hall-stage hops draw, does not hold. The audio negative was not evidence: in full-06 the detector read none of the footstep samples in the whole run, and it recovers 0 of 60 footsteps injected at the capture's own gain. Whether the phone plays those samples on camera hops stays UNKNOWN.
entries.label: SOURCED

entries.title: FNaF 4's first Night 5 died at 38.7 s, blind to Fredbear's side
entries.body: The audio carried four of Fredbear's landings, each on the level's 3000 ms grid, at matched-filter scores of 0.28 to 0.38, under the detector's 0.55 publication default, so none was published: the loop held the default left side and the panel reported a guess. The dark frames after each back were the left door view, open; the back pressed 1 ms after letting go of the door was dropped both times. The death is the hall fuse's flash, with a door held only at the left.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The FNaF 2 research rebuild installed and booted on the phone
entries.body: The practice APK installed and booted on the handset with a read-only state and input log over office updates. Title boot is its only DEVICE_MEASURED runtime observation; no office encounter trace was collected, and the APK claims no stock-game fidelity.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: The first host-versus-phone state difference on full-06 is Balloon Boy at the 40 s roll
entries.body: On full-06 the phone's hall flash is over 3 to 5 updates before the replayed hall contact releases, in every flashed cycle; monitor raises land within -2..+1 updates and mask presses within 0..-1, as the replay assumed. Aligned on the mask put-on sound, the phone's audio has Balloon Boy hopping at 40.0, 45.1 and 50.0 s and reaching the office at 60.38 s, while the rebuild and the model hold him at CAM 10 through the 40.0 and 45.0 s rolls and bring him in at 70.3 s. What held him is UNKNOWN.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: No replayed contact timing empties full-06's window 6
entries.body: Moving every hall contact 2 to 5 updates earlier, as the phone's flash frames show, changes Mangle's and Balloon Boy's later hops but never empties window 6, and releasing the mask 3 updates earlier changes nothing. Hall, mask and monitor together reach 27 of 38 agreeing windows, the best full-06 replay yet, with window 6 still Withered Bonnie. Substituting individually observed response proxies for the nightly median keeps the target disagreement too.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: A shared timing-reference error does not explain the encounter disagreements
entries.body: Sweeping a constant press-phase error and a uniform office-timer rate error, alone and together, reproduced the phone's occupied windows on no fully read night; on full-06 the best cell anywhere agrees on 32 of 42 windows against 14 for the reference, in a chaotic landscape with no basin, and window 6's disagreement stands at 41 of 44 fine cells. On full-06, the only 6 AM night, the phone ran 420.19 s from origin to 6 AM against the reconstruction's 420.01 s, so no time-losing clock error large enough to delay an encounter by 4 to 10 s occurred. Ruled out at constant-phase, uniform-rate and accumulated-loss scales.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The phone's measured clock zero and anchor phase do not explain the disagreements either
entries.body: Over four predeclared cells per traced night, the control stays best on full-06 at 14 of 42, and the joint correction dies after agreeing on 2 of 2 compared windows; on full-04 the control stays best at 4 of 8, and the joint correction dies after 3 of 3. The measured correction is rejected as the explanation; the record does not separate per-press input from a shared decoded-rule difference.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: No per-contact timing inside the measured response brackets clears window 6
entries.body: The first 1500 ms of phone window 6 admit 29 mask or monitor contacts, all with observed response brackets: 27 map to one update each and two monitor contacts to two. All four combinations keep phone windows 0 to 5 and still show Withered Bonnie in window 6.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The phone's hour transitions sit on the measured night-go anchor
entries.body: full-06's five retained hour transitions fit a 70-second grid whose zero is the first night frame plus 3836.7 ms, 0.7 ms from the anchor fire at plus 3836.0 ms. full-04's single transition before its death is a weak phase cross-check and says nothing about rate.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: All 47 promotion edges re-derive from the committed packs
entries.body: The review query re-derives 47 of 47 PROMOTED_BY edges byte for byte from 184 packs (184 GameRuns, no lift failures), all attested under the agent delegation of 2026-09-27, 11 with complete custody and 36 recovered. Open: two committed MODEL_ONLY winners no pack names (campaign-night1-minus7-winner.json, campaign-toys-night5-winner.json), and UNTRACKED_WINNER_DEBT 1 of 1. The query measures nothing and promotes nothing.
entries.label: SOURCED

entries.title: k3 on the phone's calibration build dies to one 13-tick monitor hold
entries.body: Played on the calibration build at seed 27656, k3 died at office update 5,934, with all 164 edges due by then landed (144 one update after the harness row, 19 on it, one two after). The host rebuild, given the phone's seed, frame times and landings, dies on the same update and agrees on 5,928 of 5,934, its first difference a two-draw event one update early at 4,814. At that seed and clock k3 as planned reaches 6 AM; the monitor raise planned at tick 5402, held 13 ticks where the plan holds 12, reproduces the death by itself. Rebuilt-runtime fidelity; nothing is retail evidence.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: With Foxy's hall-stage draw moved, k3's model night matches the rebuild on all 25,201 updates
entries.body: On k3 at seed 27656 the model left the rebuild at office update 362, one draw short: Withered Foxy's footstep cue draws on every hall-stage move, because g389 sets his value 2 when it moves him, while the model took that value only from his roll's acceptance. With sourcedFoxyMoveValue2 the planned night at 60 Hz matches the rebuild on 25,201 of 25,201 updates (it was 1,546). On the phone's clock the first difference moves from update 363 to 2,415, and against the phone's own night from 363 to 2,725.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The model now reproduces the rebuild's mask windows, and neither matches the phone
entries.body: Re-scored on the four clock-seeded retail nights after the Foxy value-2 change, the model on the constant clock reproduces the rebuild's mask windows on twin-01, full-04 and full-06; neither program matches the retail phone. full-06 with scheduled presses and tw-12 split earlier, because the rebuild never accepts Foxy at the roll the model accepts him on.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: FNaF 4's Night 8, 20/20/20/20, was won in the rebuilt runtime
entries.body: The rebuilt FNaF 4 reached 6 AM on Night 8, the 20/20/20/20 Nightmare, from recorded touches alone at seed 24850, and the save afterwards set beat8. The pilot that played it reads the rebuilt runtime's own objects every update, an oracle rather than a player's view, and touches only through the harness input path. MODEL_ONLY: no phone night.

entries.title: FNaF 3's Aggressive Nightmare was won in the rebuilt runtime
entries.body: The rebuilt FNaF 3 reached 6 AM on 6th Night (Nightmare) with Aggressive on, from recorded touches alone at seed 24850, played by a pilot that reads the runtime's own objects each update, an oracle rather than a player's view. MODEL_ONLY: no phone night.

entries.title: The FNaF 3 model's 65,536/65,536 is retracted: attack stage 1 has its own exit
entries.body: At stage 1 a successful roll marks Springtrap to leave (g252), and the first update with the monitor or the maintenance panel up moves him to stage 2 (g275). The model left stage 1 only on the ventilation blackout (g486), so a line that never lures could hold him there all night; the rebuilt runtime found the rule first. With it, the community line reaches 6 AM on 60,081 (Night 1) down to 20,489 (Night 6) of 65,536 seeds and 7,226 on Aggressive Nightmare, every added loss in the office; with it switched off, Night 6 returns 65,536 exactly. No policy in the model now reaches 6 AM on every seed.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: The first census over a policy family: every epoch the Night 7 anchor can deliver wins in the model
entries.body: Every earlier census scored a binding at the one epoch it declares. The phone plays a policy: the anchor releases the schedule somewhere inside an interval (aim, onset bias, 47-82 ms latency), and the binding does not choose where. Pre-registered before a seed was run, the census took j, k2 and k3 at every integer millisecond of their bands: 108 members, 32 distinct press schedules. All 32 won all 3000 seeds of the development block and all 3000 of a held-out block no tuning cohort reaches, and the device lane, each press late by its own draw from the latency band, won 3000/3000 for each binding. The band is flat, so k3's two phone losses lie outside what this lane models, or in S2.
entries.measured: 3000/3000 held-out at every one of 32 schedule classes; P_max >= 3000/3000, Wilson [0.99744, 1]
